verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a broad API surface: a Unified Payments API claiming control of "the entire payment lifecycle from a single API", payments, refunds, voids and captures, payment links, transfers, Platforms sub-entity onboarding and payouts, issuing via "open APIs", and FX rates. Webhook configuration is explicitly manageable "using the Dashboard or the API". However, nothing states general Dashboard/API parity, and for Dashboard-facing areas like risk rules, fraud reports and financial reports it is unclear whether they are API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, documented API coverage for risk rules, reporting and reconciliation, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
